verified_facts.text: The lodge is located mid-mountain at Deer Valley Resort in Park City, Utah, with direct access to skiing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Lodge is located mid-mountain at Deer Valley Resort in Park City, Utah, offering direct access to world-renowned skiing and alpine experiences.

verified_facts.text: The lodge is approximately five minutes from Historic Main Street Park City.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Lodge is approximately five minutes from Historic Main Street Park City.

verified_facts.text: Inspired by the Olympic legend Stein Eriksen and his Norwegian heritage, the traditional ski lodge was the first luxury property in Park City.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the Olympic legend and his Norwegian heritage, this traditional ski lodge was the first luxury property in Park City.

verified_facts.text: The lodge is adorned with oversized leather chairs and crackling fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adorned with oversized leather chairs, crackling fireplaces, and a welcoming ambiance

verified_facts.text: The Norwegian-style lodge has custom millwork, flower paintings from the lowland areas of eastern Norway, and leather, copper and stone elements.
verified_facts.excerpt: custom millwork, flower paintings from the lowland areas of eastern Norway, and leather, copper, and stone elements

verified_facts.text: The lodge offers direct access to lift-served hiking and biking at Deer Valley Resort, letting guests step from the lodge onto the trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Lodge offers true direct access to lift-served hiking and biking at Deer Valley Resort, allowing guests to step directly from the lodge onto the trails.

verified_facts.text: At least 80 percent of rooms have a fireplace, and all rooms have large soaking tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: At least 80 percent of rooms offer a fireplace, and all our rooms have large soaking tubs.

verified_facts.text: Many rooms have a hot tub on the deck.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many rooms also offer a hot tub on the deck.

verified_facts.text: Each Lodge Luxury Bedroom is unique in style, configuration and decor, so no two rooms are identical.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each Lodge Luxury Bedroom is unique in style, configuration, and décor making no two rooms identical.

verified_facts.text: Each Lodge Luxury Suite is individually decorated with one to five bedrooms, and most include a private deck and hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each Lodge Luxury Suite is individually decorated with one to five bedrooms and 1,200-1,400 square feet. Most of these suites include a private deck and hot tub.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have Molton Brown toiletries.
verified_facts.excerpt: bathrooms with Molton Brown toiletries

verified_facts.text: Next to the spa and fitness center is an outdoor space with two heated pools and two hot tubs, available year-round to spa guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adjacent to the Spa and Fitness Center is a large outdoor space with two heated pools and two hot tubs available year-round to all spa guests.

verified_facts.text: Spa amenities include indoor hot and cold plunge pools, steam rooms and a dry sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Indoor hot and cold plunge pools
- Steam rooms and dry sauna

verified_facts.text: Spa facility access is included with spa treatments of $100 or more.
verified_facts.excerpt: access is included with spa treatments of $100 or more

verified_facts.text: Stein Alpenglobes offer a year-round outdoor dining experience with mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: A magical year-round outdoor dining experience that pairs beautifully with the stunning mountain views and our award-winning culinary offerings.

verified_facts.text: The wine collection tops 20,000 bottles and over 2,100 selections, and private wine tastings can be arranged on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: The wine collection at Stein Eriksen Lodge tops 20,000 bottles and over 2,100 selections worth over $2.8 million

verified_facts.text: Glitretind Restaurant is open daily for dinner in summer and for breakfast, lunch and dinner in winter, with views of Deer Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open daily for dinner in the summer and for breakfast, lunch and dinner in the winter. Glitretind welcomes guests to a warm and comfortable setting framed by stunning views of Deer Valley.

verified_facts.text: Troll Hallen Lounge is the lodge's apres-ski spot, with cocktails, small plates and mountain views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy cocktails, small plates, and mountain views in a lively yet sophisticated alpine atmosphere at Troll Hallen Lounge.

verified_facts.text: Champions Club is a family entertainment center with a casual restaurant and complimentary arcade games.
verified_facts.excerpt: Champions Club offers a relaxed atmosphere with complimentary arcade games for the while family.

verified_facts.text: Stein Eriksen Sport, on the main level of the lodge, rents bikes and equipment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Sport located on the main level of the Lodge offers a great selection of bikes and equipment for rent

verified_facts.text: Most guests use the ski locker area for ski-in, ski-out access.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most guests use the ski locker area, making ski-in / ski-out access quick and easy.

verified_facts.text: The spa is 23,000 square feet with 16 treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 23,000-square-foot spa has 16 treatment rooms.

verified_facts.text: Suites come with large stone fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suites come with large stone fireplaces.

verified_facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stein Eriksen Lodge offers 24-hour in-room dining
